verdict.rationale: Crossmint runs merchant checkout products, so merchant-side agent access control is a fair question for it. The pack shows no merchant-facing way to rate-limit, allowlist, or deny specific agents or agent platforms on a catalog or checkout. The documented controls are all user-side: spend caps, counterparty limits, and merchant-locked order intents that restrict what an agent can buy. Client-side API key URL whitelisting and an unspecified 'policy engine' are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.
